scale.name: Impact
scale.description: A 0-10 customer-voice score per release, blended from app-store reviews, Steam reviews and social conversation, clustered by topic.

meta.disclaimer: Most numbers are illustrative pending source wiring; the live ones come straight from the Affogata MCP. Brand names are trademarks of their owners.

titles.name: Robinhood
titles.aiRead: New products land, outage anger flares whenever markets dip. Customers are pushing new products and UI up while outages and support drag the score, netting -0.7 on the current version.

titles.name: Trading 212
titles.aiRead: Zero-commission love, withdrawal-delay talk is the sticking point. Customers are pushing zero commission and ISA up while withdrawal delays and support drag the score, netting +2.3 on the current version.

titles.name: Wise
titles.aiRead: Trusted for FX, frozen-transfer fear is the emotional core. Customers are pushing FX rates and speed up while frozen transfers and verification drag the score, netting +1.4 on the current version.

titles.name: Remitly
titles.aiRead: Fast and reliable mostly, holds and review delays sting users. Customers are pushing fast transfers and rates up while holds / reviews and support drag the score, netting +2.7 on the current version.

titles.name: Revolut
titles.aiRead: Feature-rich, frozen-account fear drives the negative clusters. Customers are pushing FX rates and features up while frozen accounts and support drag the score, netting +2.2 on the current version.

titles.name: Raid: Shadow Legends
titles.aiRead: Loyal base, but summon-odds and ad-fatigue talk keeps the pressure high this week. Players are pushing new champions and the AC crossover up while summon odds and energy costs drag the score, netting -2.1 on the current version.

titles.name: Genshin Impact
titles.aiRead: Calmest window in a while, the usual banner-odds grumbles cooled off. Players are pushing the new region and story arc up while banner odds and power creep drag the score, netting -1.8 on the current version.

titles.name: AFK Journey
titles.aiRead: Art and story still win fans, endgame grind is where the debate lives. Players are pushing art style and story up while endgame grind and dupes drag the score, netting +0.7 on the current version.

titles.name: Baldur's Gate 3
titles.aiRead: Beloved as ever, the mod era is pulling players back in. Players are pushing mod support and cross-save up while Act 3 bugs and performance drag the score, netting +5.8 on the current version.

titles.name: Path of Exile 2
titles.aiRead: Deep endgame love, trade friction is the recurring sore spot. Players are pushing new classes and loot up while trade friction and nerfs drag the score, netting +1.5 on the current version.

titles.name: Elden Ring
titles.aiRead: DLC gave it a real lift, difficulty chatter never fully goes away. Players are pushing bosses and world up while difficulty and performance drag the score, netting +2.9 on the current version.

titles.name: Match Masters
titles.aiRead: Mixed week, the 'feels rigged' sentiment still drives most of the heat. Players are pushing new boosters and club events up while rigged feel and bots drag the score, netting -2.6 on the current version.

titles.name: Royal Match
titles.aiRead: Huge volume and mostly happy, but difficulty spikes spark churn talk. Players are pushing level design and events up while difficulty spikes and lives/energy drag the score, netting +1.3 on the current version.

titles.name: Homescapes
titles.aiRead: Story updates land well, level difficulty is the steady complaint. Players are pushing story updates and new areas up while level difficulty and ad mismatch drag the score, netting +0.2 on the current version.

titles.name: Jackpot Party
titles.aiRead: Very loud week, coin-sink and event pacing dominate the chatter. Players are pushing new slots and the daily bonus up while coin sink and odds feel drag the score, netting +0.4 on the current version.

titles.name: Huuuge Casino
titles.aiRead: Active and engaged, coin-package pricing is the main friction point. Players are pushing slot variety and clubs up while coin pricing and payout feel drag the score, netting -0.2 on the current version.

titles.name: Cashman Casino
titles.aiRead: Simple and liked, bonus pacing gripes bubble up now and then. Players are pushing classic slots and bonuses up while bonus pacing and coin drain drag the score, netting +1.4 on the current version.

titles.name: Whiteout Survival
titles.aiRead: Strong events, hero-pull odds and the P2W gap draw the noise. Players are pushing alliance play and events up while hero pull odds and the P2W gap drag the score, netting -2.0 on the current version.

titles.name: Last War: Survival
titles.aiRead: Mini-games are a hit, ad-vs-real-gameplay gap still stings. Players are pushing fun mini-games and QoL up while the ad-vs-game gap and P2W drag the score, netting -0.7 on the current version.

titles.name: Rise of Kingdoms
titles.aiRead: Alliance play holds up, pay-to-win clusters keep forming. Players are pushing alliance wars and new civs up while pay-to-win and bots drag the score, netting +1.5 on the current version.

titles.name: Counter-Strike 2
titles.aiRead: New content lands, cheaters and hit-reg are the eternal flashpoint. Players are pushing new maps and skins up while cheaters / VAC and hit-reg drag the score, netting -0.6 on the current version.

titles.name: Marvel Rivals
titles.aiRead: Hero additions keep it fresh, ranked and balance run hot. Players are pushing new heroes and maps up while ranked matchmaking and nerfs drag the score, netting -0.9 on the current version.

titles.name: Helldivers 2
titles.aiRead: Buff patch cheered, players still wary after the nerf whiplash. Players are pushing the buff patch and new enemies up while nerf backlash and crashes drag the score, netting +2.0 on the current version.

titles.name: God of War Ragnarok
titles.aiRead: Widely loved, PC polish is the only real talking point. Players are pushing story and combat up while hand-holding and PC bugs drag the score, netting +4.4 on the current version.

titles.name: Coin Master
titles.aiRead: Events drive engagement, spins pricing anger is never far off. Players are pushing events and card trading up while spins pricing and raid revenge drag the score, netting +0.2 on the current version.

titles.name: Candy Crush Saga
titles.aiRead: Comfort favorite, difficulty spikes and lives gates frustrate. Players are pushing new levels and events up while difficulty spikes and lives / energy drag the score, netting +1.6 on the current version.

titles.name: Township
titles.aiRead: Steady base, event pacing and cash cost draw the grumbles. Players are pushing new buildings and co-op up while event pacing and cash cost drag the score, netting +1.5 on the current version.

titles.name: Tinder
titles.aiRead: Feature updates land, paywall and bot complaints dominate. Users are pushing match features and UI up while the paywall and bots drag the score, netting -4.5 on the current version.

titles.name: Bumble
titles.aiRead: Women-first still resonates, match-quality debate stays live. Users are pushing women-first and safety up while match quality and price drag the score, netting -4.8 on the current version.

titles.name: Hinge
titles.aiRead: Design and intent praised, paywall creep is the rising gripe. Users are pushing prompts and intent up while paywall creep and fewer likes drag the score, netting -3.2 on the current version.

titles.name: Duolingo
titles.aiRead: Streak culture strong, the new UI genuinely split the base. Learners are pushing streaks and new courses up while the new UI and hearts limit drag the score, netting +3.5 on the current version.

titles.name: Quizlet
titles.aiRead: Flashcards loved, paywalling old features draws real anger. Learners are pushing flashcards and the AI tutor up while the paywall and ads drag the score, netting +0.0 on the current version.

titles.name: BetterHelp
titles.aiRead: Access and convenience valued, therapist churn is the main worry. Users are pushing access and convenience up while therapist churn and pricing drag the score, netting -0.3 on the current version.

titles.name: Calm
titles.aiRead: Content well-liked, subscription and auto-renew are the friction. Users are pushing sleep stories and content up while auto-renew and subscription drag the score, netting +0.8 on the current version.
